Qiyana

"The Empress of the Elements"

In the jungle city of Ixaocan, Qiyana charts her own ruthless path to the high throne of Yun Tal. Last in line to succeed her parents, she confronts those who stand in her way with brazen confidence and an unprecedented mastery of elemental magic. With the land itself obeying her every command, Qiyana sees herself as the greatest elementalist in the history of Ixaocan, and by that right, deserving of not just a city, but an empire. Though she possesses the skill to back it up, Qiyana is a proud and arrogant woman who boasts often and loudly for all to hear about her prowess with elemental magic, her ostentatious nature reflected even in her choice of attire. She thinks highly of herself and is utterly convinced that she deserves the throne regardless of her place in the line of succession. Qiyana was disgusted by the increasing number of foreign visitors coming to her jungles to drain the land of its natural resources. The primary weapon Qiyana uses in combat is an ohmlatl, a traditional Ixtali ring-shaped sword capable of acting as a medium for Qiyana's elemental magic, allowing her to infuse it with magical properties. Qiyana wields it with ease, able to spin and throw it with acrobatic force.
